payload.text: kovacs is brew-only for Utilz and Intent (hv, 19 Oct): Utilz 2.14.2 from the tap since 23 Oct (kovacs-sysadm's upgrade on hv's word, which also moved llvm to 23.1.4 and openldap to 2.7.2 through rust; dc's readbacks rb2142 and rb2142b, every keg row ok), with no dev checkout and no link into one. A brew upgrade there runs as a dry run first, since a formula's dependencies can move too. A test leg lives in its own /var/tmp run dir, ships its own tree, and is removed once its logs are back. Its cargo legs put ~/.cargo/bin first (rustup stable 1.99.1, CI's toolchain, with clippy and rustfmt), since brew's rust comes first on PATH. Nothing for acceptance (xvfb, a browser, node) is installed. A fresh Homebrew 7 needs brew trust matthewsinclair/utilz between the tap and the install. kovacs-sysadm is reachable only while this session is on Remote Control, and it acts at hv's approval in its own session. A readback's outside row reads every writer on the host (Ubuntu's once-a-day release check, a live Claude session), so name each writer from its own record.
